Ten comments

“Garrykennedy Castle” ~ composed by Paddy O’Brien

~ of Nenagh, County Tipperary…

Paddy’s composition was in F and a printed transcription of it in that key can be found here:

“The Compositions of Paddy O’Brien”
J.D.C. Publications Ltd., 1992

Page 24: “Garrykennedy Castle” K: Fmaj
|: (3CDE | FAc=B dcBc | AF ~F2 CFAF | ~ | BCDE F2 :|
|: AB | cf ~f2 cfaf | cAFA CFAc | ~ | ~F2 AG F2 :|

This is a great collection, full of lovely tunes by this talented tunesmith…

↳ Posted by ceolachan on October 21st, 2008.
